name: OCR.space
tagline: Free OCR API for image and PDF text extraction
description: OCR.space is a free OCR API that extracts text from images and PDF files via simple HTTP POST requests. It supports multi-language recognition, multiple image formats, and PDF processing with optional table recognition and search/replace features. Ideal for developers needing reliable text extraction without complex setup or infrastructure.

auth.details: API key via apikey header or form field; free key available after signup at ocr.space

pricing.free_tier_limits: 25,000 requests/month free (PRO plan has higher limits)
pricing.paid_plans: PRO plans available with higher limits and priority processing

rate_limits: Free tier: 500 requests/day, 25,000/month; rate limited per IP/key
use_cases: extract text from uploaded image files
OCR PDF documents to searchable text
batch process receipt or invoice images for data entry
convert scanned documents to plain text
